userSources.text: Create a small, playable Bubble Break ASMR game for one player on desktop and touch. The player presses individual bubbles on a reusable bubble-wrap sheet. A press visibly depresses and pops that bubble with synchronized satisfying pop audio, then adds exactly one to the popped counter after the pop completes. Holding, spamming, or pressing a popped bubble must not count twice. Let the player finish a sheet of at least twelve bubbles, see completion feedback, and deliberately reset to a fresh sheet. Use a close, readable tabletop presentation and minimal counter/reset UI. Search Marketplace first for a complete reusable interaction, including any existing geometry, animation, sounds and behavior; inspect what it already provides and integrate only missing features. Search separately for missing media if needed. Audio must come from Marketplace and actually play. Record unavailable importer capabilities rather than pretending a suitable scripted component does not exist. Choose reasonable details yourself; no saving, multiplayer, purchases or large map. Success needs observed press/pop/recovery timing, per-bubble state, exact counting, sheet completion/reset and usable desktop/touch input. Do not claim success from code inspection alone.

playerExperience.title: Bubble Break ASMR
playerExperience.summary: A cozy, tactile, single-player tabletop ASMR bubble wrap popping experience for desktop and touch. The player sits before a realistic, translucent bubble wrap sheet laid out on a warm wooden desk. The sheet features a 4x4 grid of 16 interactive domed bubbles. Clicking or tapping an unpopped bubble triggers a physical press depression animation, plays a crisp satisfying popping sound, bursts the bubble into a deflated state with soft particle feedback, and increments the popped counter by exactly one upon pop completion. Rapid clicking, holding, or tapping already popped bubbles is debounced and ignored. Once all 16 bubbles are popped, completion fanfare and a completion banner trigger. A clean, minimal UI provides a live counter (Popped: X / 16) and a dedicated 'Reset Sheet' button that smoothly restores all bubbles to their pristine state.
playerExperience.visualDirection: Cozy minimalist tabletop aesthetic. The camera is framed close and slightly angled down toward a smooth cedar wood desk with warm, soft ambient lighting and subtle depth of field. The bubble wrap sheet has a translucent, faintly cyan-tinted smooth plastic material with gentle specular highlights. Each bubble dome rises smoothly above the sheet base. When pressed, the dome flattens, emits a micro air burst particle effect, and settles into a deflated wrinkled ring appearance. The UI is minimal, rounded, semi-transparent, and docked cleanly at the top and bottom corners with high-contrast text and tactile button states.

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local part = script.Parent
local clickDetector = part:WaitForChild("ClickDetector")
local clickSound = part:WaitForChild("Click")
local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")

local originalPosition = part.Position
local originalTransparency = part.Transparency
local originalMeshScale = mesh and mesh.Scale or Vector3.new(1, 1, 1)

local isPopped = false

local function pop()
	if isPopped then return end
	isPopped = true
	part:SetAttribute("Popped", true)
	clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 0
	
	clickSound:Play()
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.08, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	if mesh then
		local targetScale = Vector3.new(originalMeshScale.X * 1.15, originalMeshScale.Y * 0.25, originalMeshScale.Z * 1.15)
		TweenService:Create(mesh, tweenInfo, { Scale = targetScale }):Play()
	end
	
	local partTween = TweenService:Create(part, tweenInfo, {
		Transparency = math.clamp(originalTransparency + 0.35, 0, 0.85),
		Position = originalPosition - Vector3.new(0, 0.08, 0)
	})
	partTween:Play()
	partTween.Completed:Wait()
	
	local current = script.Parent
	while current and current.Name ~= "working bubble wrap" and current.Parent do
		current = current.Parent
	end
	if current then
		local popEvent = current:FindFirstChild("BubblePoppedEvent")
		if popEvent and popEvent:IsA("BindableEvent") then
			popEvent:Fire(part)
		end
	end
end

local function reset()
	isPopped = false
	part:SetAttribute("Popped", false)
	clickDetector.MaxActivationDistance = 32
	
	local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
	if mesh then
		TweenService:Create(mesh, tweenInfo, { Scale = originalMeshScale }):Play()
	end
	TweenService:Create(part, tweenInfo, {
		Transparency = originalTransparency,
		Position = originalPosition
	}):Play()
end

clickDetector.MouseClick:Connect(function()
	pop()
end)

part:GetAttributeChangedSignal("ResetBubble"):Connect(function()
	if part:GetAttribute("ResetBubble") == true then
		reset()
		part:SetAttribute("ResetBubble", false)
	end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local model = script.Parent
local bubbleWrapModel = model:WaitForChild("bubble wrap")

local popEvent = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
popEvent.Name = "BubblePoppedEvent"
popEvent.Parent = model

local netFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
netFolder.Name = "BubbleBreakNetwork"
netFolder.Parent = model

local stateRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
stateRemote.Name = "StateUpdate"
stateRemote.Parent = netFolder

local resetRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
resetRemote.Name = "ResetRequest"
resetRemote.Parent = netFolder

local bubbleParts = {}
for _, child in ipairs(bubbleWrapModel:GetChildren()) do
	if child:IsA("BasePart") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector") then
		child.Anchored = true
		table.insert(bubbleParts, child)
	end
end

local totalBubbles = #bubbleParts
local poppedSet = {}
local poppedCount = 0

local function broadcastState()
	stateRemote:FireAllClients({
		poppedCount = poppedCount,
		totalCount = totalBubbles,
		isComplete = (poppedCount >= totalBubbles and totalBubbles > 0)
	})
end

popEvent.Event:Connect(function(part)
	if not poppedSet[part] then
		poppedSet[part] = true
		poppedCount = math.min(poppedCount + 1, totalBubbles)
		broadcastState()
	end
end)

local function resetSheet()
	poppedSet = {}
	poppedCount = 0
	for _, part in ipairs(bubbleParts) do
		part:SetAttribute("ResetBubble", true)
	end
	broadcastState()
end

resetRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player)
	resetSheet()
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	task.wait(0.5)
	stateRemote:FireClient(player, {
		poppedCount = poppedCount,
		totalCount = totalBubbles,
		isComplete = (poppedCount >= totalBubbles and totalBubbles > 0)
	})
end)

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local netFolder = model:WaitForChild("BubbleBreakNetwork", 10)
if not netFolder then return end

local stateRemote = netFolder:WaitForChild("StateUpdate")
local resetRemote = netFolder:WaitForChild("ResetRequest")

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLabel.Text = "BUBBLE BREAK ASMR"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(160, 210, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 13
titleLabel.Parent = topCard

local counterLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

counterLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
counterLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 28)
counterLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
counterLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
counterLabel.Text = "Popped: 0 / ..."
counterLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
counterLabel.TextSize = 18
counterLabel.Parent = topCard

local resetBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
resetBtn.Name = "ResetButton"
resetBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44)
resetBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -80, 1, -64)
resetBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 120, 235)
resetBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
resetBtn.Text = "Reset Sheet"
resetBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
resetBtn.TextSize = 15
resetBtn.AutoButtonColor = false
resetBtn.Parent = screenGui

local resetCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
resetCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
resetCorner.Parent = resetBtn

local resetStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
resetStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
resetStroke.Transparency = 0.75
resetStroke.Thickness = 1.2
resetStroke.Parent = resetBtn

local completionBanner = Instance.new("Frame")
completionBanner.Name = "CompletionBanner"
completionBanner.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 52)
completionBanner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.45, -26)
completionBanner.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 160, 90)
completionBanner.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15
completionBanner.Visible = false
completionBanner.Parent = screenGui

local bannerCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
bannerCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
bannerCorner.Parent = completionBanner

local bannerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
bannerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
bannerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bannerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
bannerLabel.Text = "✨ Sheet Complete! Pure ASMR Bliss ✨"
bannerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
bannerLabel.TextSize = 15
bannerLabel.Parent = completionBanner

resetBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(resetBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 140, 255)}):Play()
end)

resetBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(resetBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.12), {BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 120, 235)}):Play()
end)

resetBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(resetBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.06), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 152, 0, 40), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -76, 1, -62)}):Play()
end)

resetBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function()
	TweenService:Create(resetBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.06), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 44), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -80, 1, -64)}):Play()
	resetRemote:FireServer()
end)

stateRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(data)
	if not data then return end
	counterLabel.Text = string.format("Popped: %d / %d", data.poppedCount, data.totalCount)
	
	if data.isComplete then
		completionBanner.Visible = true
		completionBanner.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.4, -26)
		TweenService:Create(completionBanner, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
			Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -170, 0.45, -26)
		}):Play()
	else
		completionBanner.Visible = false
	end
end)
